note: Sizes are the download as Ollama reports it, rounded. Approximate and dated on purpose: the true total is reported by the pull itself and is what the progress bar counts against.

models.name: qwen3:0.6b
models.why: The smallest one that holds a conversation, and small enough to finish on a metered connection. Thin on anything hard.

models.name: qwen3:1.7b
models.why: Noticeably better, if the download is affordable.

models.name: qwen3:4b
models.why: Writes, edits and summarises well for its size, and reads a long document in one go.

models.name: qwen3:8b
models.why: The usual choice on a modest card. Good at the jobs a local model does well, and quick enough to feel instant.

models.name: qwen3:4b
models.why: Smaller and faster, and it reads a long document in one go.

models.name: gemma4:12b-it-qat
models.why: Reads pictures as well as text, calls tools on its own, and holds a long document. Trained at the size it ships in, so it loses less than an ordinary 4-bit build.

models.name: qwen3:8b
models.why: Smaller and quicker, if the card is doing other work.

models.name: qwen3.8:27b
models.why: For a card with room to spare. Reads pictures, calls tools, thinks before answering, and holds a very long document.

models.name: gemma4:26b-a4b-it-qat
models.why: Large, but only a few of its experts answer each word, so it replies at about the speed of a small model.

models.name: gemma4:12b-it-qat
models.why: Reads pictures, calls tools, and leaves most of the card free.
